content.text: In regions like Nigeria and Zimbabwe, conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-4|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal leave digital creators stranded. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-18|The COREMERCH]] offers a solution that builds a fully operational crypto store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-12|cloudflare]] Pages, removing the dependency on these platforms. This guide will show you how to deploy your store using Stack 02 in a streamlined manner within 48 hours, ensuring you take control of your online commerce without barriers.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Digital creators face significant challenges when traditional payment processors are unavailable. COREMERCH's architecture is built for sovereignty, allowing you to own your entire digital commerce stack. With Cloudflare Pages, your store is hosted on a reliable, free platform, while NOWPayments provides seamless crypto transactions without KYC requirements. This combination ensures that you maintain full control and ownership of your products and customer data, circumventing the restrictions imposed by conventional payment systems.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start, gather essential tools: a Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account for processing transactions, and a GitHub account for version control. Familiarize yourself with Google Sheets or Supabase for order management. You will also need your digital products ready for upload, which could include ebooks, courses, or software. Ensure that you have a clear understanding of how to configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email deliverability. This preparation sets the stage for a smooth deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your backend using Cloudflare Workers, which will handle the logic for payment processing and product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Next, configure your Supabase or Google Sheets to store order details. Make sure to test the payment flow in a staging environment before going live. This initial setup is critical to ensure that your customers can purchase and receive products without delays or errors.
Sovereignty means you own everything; no strings attached.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your setup is complete and tested, it's time to go live. Update your DNS settings in Cloudflare to point to your new store. Promote your store link, ideally pointing your customers to https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, where they can explore your offerings. Monitor the first transactions closely to ensure everything functions as expected. This is your opportunity to establish a seamless shopping experience, reinforcing your commitment to sovereignty in digital commerce.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your initial deployment, focus on scaling your operations. Utilize the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for enhanced features like multiple product listings and improved email configurations. Continuously engage your customer base through effective marketing strategies, and consider expanding your product range. Regularly analyze transaction data to gain insights into customer preferences, allowing you to optimize your offerings further. With your infrastructure in place, growth becomes a natural progression.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Deploy infrastructure in under 48 hours with COREMERCH.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments, use Cloudflare Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for transaction processing. This combination allows you to create a fully functional store at no cost.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages with Workers and Supabase, enabling deployment within 48 hours with comprehensive testing.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Each platform offers unique advantages, with Cloudflare providing additional functionality through Workers for backend processing.
What payment options does NOWPayments support?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital currencies with only a 0.5% processing fee. This flexibility is crucial for catering to diverse customer preferences.
How can I ensure my customers receive their digital products seamlessly?

To ensure customers receive their products seamlessly, set up an automated delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage. Test the integration thoroughly to confirm the process works without issues.
